articles.title: Man seriously injured in East York hit-and-run
articles.summary: A man has suffered serious injures in a hit-and-run in East York Friday afternoon. Toronto police were called to Mortimer and Durant avenues just after 3 p.m. for reports of a collision. A 40-year-old man was struck by a vehicle and the driver involved did not remain at the scene, according to police. The man […]

articles.title: Ontario Premier Ford says automaker Stellantis owes feds $873M
articles.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says Stellantis owes the federal government "roughly" $873 million, as Ottawa and the province look for a way to reopen the automaker's Brampton plant.

articles.title: Police didn’t consider key factors in Francique arrest plan, inquest hears
articles.summary: A coroner’s inquest into the fatal shooting of a Black man by a police officer is hearing that police did not anticipate several factors, including the man’s previous victimization. Peel regional police Det. Jason Sweeting said the arrest plan for Jamal Francique did not account for the speed at which he would walk from his […]

articles.title: Child attacked by coyote at Edwards Gardens in Toronto, police say
articles.summary: Police are warning the public after a coyote attacked a child in a northeast Toronto park this week.

articles.title: Child attacked by coyote in Edwards Gardens: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto Police have issued a public safety alert after a child was attacked by a coyote in a park in the area of Lawrence Avenue East and The Bridle Path on Thursday. The attack took place just after 11:30 a.m. in Edwards Gardens. The child was dragged some distance before bystanders were able to scare […]

articles.title: Nikhil Gupta sentenced to over 19 years in prison for plot to kill U.S.-Canadian activist
articles.summary: An Indian man was sentenced to more than 19 years in prison in a federal court in New York on Friday after admitting guilt in a plot to kill dual U.S.-Canadian citizen Gurpatwant Pannun.

articles.title: Ford Motor Co. officially producing Super Duty trucks at Oakville, Ont., assembly plant after retool
articles.summary: Ford Motor Co. is betting its Oakville, Ont., assembly complex can help the company drive growth and demonstrate the automaker's commitment to Canadian manufacturing for the long haul.

articles.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ sets record with $3.79B in first-day retail sales, Rockstar Games reports
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Sales of “Grand Theft Auto VI” generated a record with $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales, maker Rockstar Games said Friday, underscoring the enormous demand for the first new installment in the blockbuster series in 13 years.

articles.title: 60-year-old driver charged after crash that killed pedestrian in August: Durham police
articles.summary: On Aug. 18, officers responded after a man on rollerblades was struck by a transport truck driven by a 60-year-old man in Ajax, Ont., Durham police said. Three months later, the driver has been charged with careless driving causing death.

articles.title: Fuel truck crash, fire closes Highway 401 eastbound near Trenton
articles.summary: Ontario Provincial Police say a fuel truck crashed and caught fire near Highway 401's Wooler Road interchange Friday morning. There were closures on the 401 and County Road 40 until around 9:30 a.m.

articles.title: Peel Region's new council chair on the 'tumultuous new world' of strong regional chairs
articles.summary: Peel Region's new provincially appointed council chair said he recognizes the "tumultuous" circumstances that led to his appointment, during his first message to council on inauguration day.

articles.title: Man dead after being struck by vehicle in Mississauga, police say
articles.summary: A man is dead after being struck by a vehicle in Mississauga on Thursday evening, police say.

articles.title: Vehicle ticketed in Toronto minutes after rush hour sign change — and driver is not happy
articles.summary: A Toronto resident is speaking out after he received a $120 parking ticket in Parkdale minutes after crews took down old traffic signs and put up new ones that changed the no-stopping times on a stretch of Queen Street W. Police say they will request tickets issued during the sign change be cancelled.
